capabilities: decrypt selected Evernote encrypted text via password prompt
decrypt and replace encrypted text in place
encrypt selected text as the Evernote secret format
format encrypted strings as clickable secret buttons
find encrypted data by its RU5DM prefix
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose note encryption tool; it only handles Evernote's en-crypt format.
extras: Only Evernote's AES-128 encryption (from 2014 onward) is supported; older RC2-encrypted data is not. The companion importer plugin is not on the community list and must be installed via BRAT with a frozen version tag.
problem: Notes imported from Evernote contain encrypted blobs that appear as unreadable text and cannot be opened or re-encrypted inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: When you import notes from Evernote by importer plugin, encrypted data in Evernote is imported as a text.
This plugin is inspired by the inline-encrypter.
obsidian-importer-for-evernote-decryptor is a forked version of importer plugin

summary: Decrypts Evernote en-crypt data in imported notes and encrypts or formats selected text as clickable Evernote secret buttons.
